task: Close the candidate playbook activation loop by letting explicit exposure and structured outcome evidence activate advisory playbooks through playbook_auto_promotion_apply.
outcome: After a candidate receives three explicit helped candidate-inspection outcomes, running lattice playbook_auto_promotion_apply --apply --json prints activatedCount:1, then lattice playbook_runtime_consumption_verify --json shows that playbook consumed by active runtime checks; the same command fails closed before outcome evidence and DONE success alone never counts as helped.
facts: B-c28f already made DONE experience observable as done_experience seeds and candidate playbooks, but candidates remain inert.
Current playbook_auto_promotion_apply implements guarded activation, but a separate promotion_sweep apply flag/manual step is still needed to write recommend_activate decisions.
PLAYBOOK_DONE_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED is default-on and writes health rows only; DONE success alone is not helped outcome evidence.
playbook_runtime_consumption_verify can prove active playbooks surface while candidates remain inert.
constraints: Do not create lifecycle gate evidence, production readiness, or blocking policy from playbooks.
Do not add timer/daemon rollout mechanics, historical backfill, or broad rollout mechanics in this story.
Activation must require explicit concrete exposure, structured helped outcomes, clean lineage, current candidate digest, and no harmful/wrong-claim signals.
Use host-neutral Lattice workflow commands and keep Codex/Claude naming out of workflow command namespaces.
unknowns: Whether the existing auto-apply report can write the deterministic recommend_activate decision itself without weakening digest checks.
Whether the existing smoke can be extended through real dist CLI for outcome_record, auto_promotion_apply, and runtime verification without requiring live project data mutation.
